routes.label: Count subsets and exclude the full set

question: How many proper subsets does a set with 3 elements have?
solution: There are 8 subsets in total. Each of the three elements can be included or omitted, and the \(2\times2\times2=8\) resulting choice patterns give every subset exactly once. Excluding the set itself leaves 7 proper subsets.
